images.caption: Figure 1:F2G-Pose Overview.Given a cropped RGB image and segmented partial point cloud, F2G-Pose extracts dense RADIOv2.5 features[13]and lifts them onto 3D points by projection. DGCNN tokenization produces fused RGB-D object tokens, and a MoE Transformer encodes a global object representation. Two parallel decoder branches directly predict (i) 6D pose and metric size and (ii) camera-frame completed shape through coarse-to-fine refinement. The pipeline produces a pose-size-shape estimate in one feed-forward pass.
Figure 2:Qualitative results on ROPE. We show the input RGB image, ground-truth pose, poses from GenPose++ and F2G-Pose, and the predicted camera-frame shape.
